newsitem.title: UK: UK delivered grains active, fob quiet.
newsitem.headline: UK delivered grains active, fob quiet.

text.p: Traders on the UK cash grain markets were having mixed fortunes on Tuesday with delivered traders reporting a fairly active day while fob players said their sector was very quiet.
"People are getting concern that some of our export business is going to Denmark where the grain is cheaper," said one trader.
Traders reported no fob business although there were markets for February feed wheat at 94.50 to 95 stg and for April/June at 96.75 to 97.25 stg.
On the delivered market feed wheat was fetching 94 stg for January in East Anglia and 99.50 stg for January/March 1998.
Feed barley in East Anglia traded at 95 stg for February and 96 stg for October/December.
